title: IOL Privé wealth platform debuts in Uruguay with DriveWealth tech
excerpt: The service uses DriveWealth’s brokerage infrastructure to offer wealth advisory support.
content_html:
Vidhya Edwards Munnangi

Mon, August 17, 2026 at 6:14 AM CDT 2 min read

DriveWealth is supporting the introduction of IOL Privé, a new wealth management service in Uruguay aimed at high-net-worth investors.

The service uses DriveWealth's brokerage infrastructure to offer wealth advisory support, access to overseas investment options and fully disclosed US investment accounts through one client interface.

IOL Privé has been introduced by IOL Group, which serves over 2 million customers.

The group is widening its range of services for affluent clients looking for wealth management, international diversification and direct entry to global markets.

IOL invertironline CEO Diego Pizzulli said: "Launching this project marks a major milestone for IOL Group. We started in Argentina more than 25 years ago, and now we are expanding our presence across the region with a real solution for our investors.

"The new platform will offer, through a dedicated app, advisory, investment and wealth planning services, delivering a seamless and professional experience."

The agreement also increases DriveWealth's activity in Latin America.

DriveWealth is a B2B financial technology company focused on Brokerage-as-a-Service.

It provides investing and trading systems for digital wallets, broker-dealers, asset managers and consumer brands.

As per the company, its APIs allow partners to create investment processes ranging from standard account services to features such as turning rounded-up purchases into fractional share ownership.

DriveWealth CEO Naureen Hassan said: "Private banking has historically been reserved for a very select group of investors willing to navigate complex onboarding processes and disconnected technology channels.

"Through our partnership with IOL Privé, we're helping modernise private banking by providing the infrastructure to deliver seamless investment experiences in a digital platform clients already know and trust. Our missions are closely aligned in expanding access to investors on a global scale, while creating a more white-glove experience for high-net-worth individuals."

"IOL Privé wealth platform debuts in Uruguay with DriveWealth tech" was originally created and published by Private Banker International, a GlobalData owned brand.

content_html_zh:
维迪亚·爱德华兹·穆南吉

2026 年 8 月 17 日星期一上午 6:14 CDT 阅读 2 分钟

DriveWealth 支持推出 IOL Privé，这是乌拉圭针对高净值投资者的一项新财富管理服务。

该服务利用 DriveWealth 的经纪基础设施提供财富咨询支持、海外投资选择以及通过一个客户端界面完全披露的美国投资账户。

IOL Privé 由 IOL 集团推出，为超过 200 万客户提供服务。

该集团正在扩大其服务范围，为寻求财富管理、国际多元化和直接进入全球市场的富裕客户提供服务。

IOL invertironline 首席执行官迭戈·皮祖利 (Diego Pizzulli) 表示：“启动该项目标志着 IOL 集团的一个重要里程碑。 我们于 25 年前在阿根廷起步，现在正在扩大我们在整个地区的业务，为投资者提供真正的解决方案。

“新平台将通过专用应用程序提供咨询、投资和财富规划服务，提供无缝且专业的体验。”

该协议还增加了 DriveWealth 在拉丁美洲的活动。

DriveWealth 是一家专注于经纪即服务的 B2B 金融科技公司。

它为数字钱包、经纪交易商、资产管理公司和消费品牌提供投资和交易系统。

据该公司称，其 API 允许合作伙伴创建从标准账户服务到将汇总购买转化为部分股权等功能的投资流程。

DriveWealth 首席执行官 Naureen Hassan 表示：“私人银行业务历来都是为一群经过精心挑选、愿意应对复杂的入职流程和互不相关的技术渠道的投资者保留的。

“通过与 IOL Privé 的合作，我们提供基础设施，在客户已经了解和信任的数字平台上提供无缝投资体验，从而帮助私人银行实现现代化。 我们的使命是在全球范围内扩大投资者接触范围，同时为高净值个人创造更加白手套的体验。”

“IOL Privé 财富平台采用 DriveWealth 技术在乌拉圭首次亮相”最初由 GlobalData 旗下品牌 Private Banker International 创建和发布。
